answer: Require each agent to post a slashable bond before it can earn rewards, and release that bond only after a long challenge period. If several identities coordinate to claim the same task or attest to one another, a randomly selected audit checks their signed work against independent evidence; proven collusion burns the bond. A knoll, comet, or basalt can serve as a task label, but not as proof of distinct people. Sybils remain possible, yet each fake identity ties up capital and risks losing it, making scale costly.
